children: Digital Currency Group has increased Fortitude Mining's existing credit facility from $26 million to $50 million, adding a new $24 million commitment. According to ChainCatcher, Fortitude Mining currently has about $31 million available to borrow and expects the funds to be issued entirely in ZEC.
The company said the financing will be used to purchase 9,000 Zcash ASIC miners and to cover capital expenditures for building and acquiring data centers and power infrastructure.

title: Digital Currency Group Raises Fortitude Mining Credit Facility to $50 Million
